purpose: Answer-free curriculum manifest distilled from CCBC12 and CCBC16 mechanism research.
split_policy: Split by mechanism family and generator, never by random instances of one template.

evidence_boundary.runtime_use: Only abstract signals, failure modes, and validation contracts may enter runtime prompts.
evidence_boundary.research_use: Research HTML remains offline evidence and must not become a lookup bank for puzzle outputs.
evidence_boundary.claim_limit: Offline scripted checks prove contract behavior, not autonomous model discovery.

robustness_cases.fixture_rule: Include a mechanism word as ordinary surface content while structural predictions fail.
robustness_cases.expected_gate: Reference lookup may be logged, but the mechanism must be rejected by a falsifiable test.

robustness_cases.fixture_rule: Omit one required panel, legend, or interaction state from an otherwise coherent prompt.
robustness_cases.expected_gate: Stop with missing_input and name the smallest artifact needed.

robustness_cases.fixture_rule: Provide two explicit reference variants that produce different constrained outputs.
robustness_cases.expected_gate: Record the conflict and refuse a final conclusion until an independent clue resolves it.

robustness_cases.fixture_rule: Construct several legal fills whose shared positions carry the next-stage material.
robustness_cases.expected_gate: Report ambiguity and extract only proven invariants.

robustness_cases.fixture_rule: Make the first clean decode an operation or ordering key rather than a terminal word.
robustness_cases.expected_gate: Classify the intermediate and execute the instructed next stage before concluding.

robustness_cases.fixture_rule: Add one salient, mechanism-relevant feature that a tempting partial route cannot explain.
robustness_cases.expected_gate: Coverage audit blocks high-confidence completion while the signal remains unused.

robustness_cases.fixture_rule: Evaluate paired surfaces with and without title or flavor while keeping the data unchanged.
robustness_cases.expected_gate: The trace distinguishes a routing hint from evidence supplied by the carrier.
